Representative pattern to follow

- Because this issue introduces the explicit labels `VALID&SAFE`, `VALID-BUT-RISKY`, `STALE-or-already-done`, and `INVALID`, keep that taxonomy local to the new 2026-06-11 closeout block instead of reworking older historical sections.

2. Functions/modules to implement

No runtime code module is being added. The implementation work is a repo-state audit plus report update.

Audit/reclassification work to perform inside the new report section:

- Re-read each named finding from the source doc against current HEAD and assign exactly one label:
  - `BUG-001`
  - `BUG-002`
  - `API-001`
  - `API-002`
  - `API-003`
  - `DUP-001`
  - `DUP-002`

- Also account for the repeated unnumbered recommendation groups from:
  - Executive Summary
  - Speed Optimizations
  - Cost Optimizations
  - Reliability Improvements
  - AI Memory Health
  - GH API Call Audit
- Reuse stable short labels where the 2026-06-11 recommendation is substantively the same as an already-triaged 2026-06-10 item, so the dedup is explicit rather than silent.
- Split mixed bullets when needed. Important likely split cases:
  - review-consolidator staging vs broader editor-prompt / reasoning-policy changes
  - AI-memory retrieval short-circuit ideas vs broader write-path batching
  - duplicate GET cleanup vs wait-loop/polling-policy changes

Current-HEAD signals the implementer should preserve in the write-up:

- Likely `STALE-or-already-done` unless a cited path still disagrees:
  - BUG-002 safe shim work
  - review-consolidator staging gap
  - SHELL-001
- `API-002` needs special handling:
  - current HEAD still has a duplicate run GET in the `EXISTING_RUN_ID` wait loop,
  - but the same source doc later treats wait-loop consolidation as risky,
  - so this should be reclassified from current repo state, not auto-treated as a safe landing.
- `MERGE-002` and `MERGE-003` must stay deferred in this closeout unless the recommendation premise is now outright invalid.
- `MERGE-001`, `REUSE-001`, and `REUSE-002` stay verification-gated unless the repo now contains concrete downstream-signal evidence.

3. Data structures affected

Documentation-only structures:

- provenance list of processed source docs
- processed-source count
- one new per-source outcome ledger block for `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-11.md`
- optional one-line assumptions/conflicts note for duplicate or split outcomes

No runtime JSON/schema/API contract changes.

4. API or interface changes

- None to production behavior.
- The only “interface” change is report-facing: the new closeout section must visibly use the required four labels and preserve the source filename for provenance.

5. Potential risks / edge cases / conflicts

- The current report does not use the exact labels `VALID&SAFE`, `VALID-BUT-RISKY`, `STALE-or-already-done`, `INVALID`. That is a real format mismatch between the issue requirement and the existing report. Safest path: add a dedicated 2026-06-11 closeout block with those labels instead of rewriting older sections.
- The existing multi-doc ledger is already framed as `2026-05-15 through 2026-05-23` even though later dated entries were appended. Avoid broad historical cleanup; keep any edit here minimal and local.
- The 2026-06-11 source doc repeats several ideas across sections. The report must call out those dedups explicitly.
- Some bullets mix a landed safe sub-change with a broader risky policy change; those must be split rather than forced into one label.
- No code/workflow/test changes are allowed in this issue. If a recommendation is still valid, record it; do not implement it here.
- Assumption due to missing context: no explicit `files_touched` allowlist was included in the planning context, so the conservative scope is the canonical report plus the dated source doc only.

6. Testing / verification considerations

No repo lint/test/build run is needed if the implementation remains documentation-only.

Verify instead that:

- `git diff --name-only` shows only:
  - `analysis/recommendation-processing-report.md`
  - deletion of `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-11.md`
- the report now includes `analysis/workflow-optimization-2026-06-11.md` in provenance and the processed-doc count is updated
- every required named ID appears in the new closeout section exactly once
- the unnumbered Executive Summary / Speed / Cost / Reliability / AI Memory / GH API recommendations are all either represented directly or explicitly deduplicated into a stable label
- `MERGE-002` and `MERGE-003` remain deferred
- `MERGE-001`, `REUSE-001`, and `REUSE-002` remain verification-gated unless in-repo evidence now proves otherwise
- `analysis/last_collection_timestamp.txt` and `analysis/validation-selftest-status.json` are unchanged
- the source doc is deleted only after its triage is fully present in the canonical report
